_about: The only paths builder_paths.py accepts in a shipped bundle or installer payload. Each is in a third-party file Angelo ships unchanged; none is Angelo's own builder. 'files' are globs over the path relative to the scanned folder (fnmatch: * also matches /, so a leading * fits a bundle, a mounted disk image and an unpacked MSI alike), 'match' must match the whole hit. Credentials and the building machine's own names are never allowed. Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer can check.

allow.reason: Blender's precompiled macOS libraries (lib/macos_arm64 at the pinned commit) and the Python built with them were built on Blender's library build machine; Blender's own releases carry the same strings

OpenAI's CI build path in their signed, unmodified helper; we cannot rebuild it. These are OpenAI's unchanged, OpenAI-signed release executables of the pinned Codex tag, built on GitHub's hosted runners (generic accounts 'runner' and 'runneradmin'; on Windows also the account folder's 8.3 form RUNNER~1, e.g. aws-lc's __FILE__ under C:\Users\RUNNER~1\CARGO~1\registry)
Documentation and test examples in the Python standard library and its bundled packages (docstrings, setuptools' distutils tests, meson's pkg-config examples, and their bytecode), as they ship
Blender's own startup and asset .blend files, compiled into the executable, keep the library paths their authors saved them with (upstream data, unchanged)
